transcript.text: Romeo Moreno, Noam Dar, you have fought your way to get here. Overcome every obstacle possible and now you can officially call yourselves the winners of the Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic. Tell us, what does this victory mean to you?
El Classical winners, championies. For me, this time last year, I was considering retiring. Two long-term injuries, I really thought my destiny was to be in the alley eating pork and beans.
But tonight, after that win, we've got our King's and Queen's!
When I came here a year ago, I felt alone. I felt like there were so many opinions, I lost myself in the process. And I had no one. Everyone was far away until I met you.
So not only in the ring, thank you for always said the ring, I love your mind.
I'm Manu. Let's go just the beginning, mate. So, hey, we're not playing chess. No checkmates. We're making money. Checkmate!
